summary.intent: Finish the CipherBox v2 wayfinder map (final ticket: deploy/CI/release blueprint), then plan and execute the v1 freeze and kickoff of the v2 rewrite in the cipher-box repo — including cleaning up v1 artifacts, adopting the AGENTS.md pattern, rewriting docs, and scaffolding the v2 workspace with day-one CI gates.
summary.outcome: Ticket #48 and the wayfinder map were closed with blueprint/deploy.md merged; v1 was frozen at branch `v1`/tag `v1-freeze`; handover PR #616 (GSD removal, AGENTS.md source-of-truth, README/SECURITY.md rewrite, landing npm→pnpm) merged after fixing stale required-status-check blockers; v2 workspace scaffold PR #617 was opened with cargo+TS workspaces green, and CI fixes (rust-toolchain components, zizmor offline flag) were being pushed when the transcript ends.

repo: cipher-box uses 1Password SSH commit signing (gpg.format=ssh, op-ssh-sign) which intermittently hangs/wedges — always timeout-guard signed commits and verify landing via `git log` before retrying rather than assuming failure.
Never use `--no-gpg-sign`/`--no-verify` unless the user explicitly authorizes it in the moment (e.g. while AFK); it's not a standing permission.

GitHub branch protection can hold stale required status-check contexts referencing workflows that were deleted — these block merges forever with 'expected — waiting for status update' and must be removed from the ruleset once their producing workflow is gone.
release-please rule: never leave a `release-as` pin equal to its `.release-please-manifest.json` version — causes a self-comparing re-release loop; no longer CI-enforced so must be checked manually.
rust-toolchain.toml must explicitly declare `components = ["rustfmt", "clippy"]` — otherwise CI resolves a minimal profile lacking them, breaking lint/fmt gates.
The `landing/` app (Astro) sits outside the pnpm workspace; `pnpm install`/`build` there requires `--ignore-workspace`, otherwise pnpm silently operates against the repo root instead.
zsh aborts an entire compound command (not just the failing segment) on an unmatched glob — split glob-bearing commands out separately.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL deprecation; use `gh api -X PATCH ... -F body=@file` instead.
`gh issue view --comments` also fails via GraphQL; use REST (`gh api repos/.../issues/N/comments`) instead.
zizmor CI failures can be either a transient GitHub API 503 on the advisories endpoint or a real finding — distinguish by re-fetching the log/rerunning before treating as a flake.

code.finding: Needed `components = ["rustfmt", "clippy"]` added — CI's default toolchain resolution otherwise omits these and fails the Cargo Linux job.
Fixed to pass an offline-audits flag after a repeat non-503 failure, verified locally against zizmor before pushing.
Rewritten as the day-one v2 PR gate (Lint/Typecheck/Test/Build/Cargo x3); dropped api-spec, sdk-e2e, migration-check, and vector-parity jobs which depended on now-deleted v1 apps/packages.
build-tee job and tee/redis/SendGrid env plumbing removed as part of the v2 staging simplification (redis + tee-worker leave the stack per blueprint/deploy.md).
redis and tee-worker services removed from local dev compose to match the v2 stack shape.

workflow: For structural doc migrations (CLAUDE.md → AGENTS.md), grep the whole repo for references to the old file afterward, but skip hits inside code slated for demolition — only fix live/tooling references.

When deleting large tracked trees (e.g. .planning/, GSD install), verify nothing untracked/live depends on them (statusline scripts, hook wiring) before nuking, and check for hook/permission entries in settings.local.json that reference the deleted tooling.
When a user corrects an over-aggressive deletion (ship-phase.md), recover the original via `git show HEAD~N:path` rather than reconstructing from memory, then adapt rather than restore verbatim.
Distinguish infra flakes from real CI failures before spending effort investigating: retry/refetch the log first.

Background watcher tasks for long CI runs are useful but must be re-kicked against each new HEAD after a push, and can get silently 'stopped' across session boundaries — check for a completion record and inspect the output file for partial results before assuming success.

friction: 1Password SSH signing hung/failed multiple times, requiring several retries with increasing timeouts and eventually a background retry loop before the user authorized an unsigned commit.
GitHub API 503s intermittently blocked fetching CI failure logs, requiring repeated retries.
A zsh unmatched-glob pattern silently aborted an entire compound rm command mid-cleanup.
python's yaml module and ruby's `safe_load`/`aliases:` were unavailable/unsupported for validating workflow YAML, requiring a fallback to plain `YAML.load`.
Injected a duplicate `name:` line into deploy-staging.yml from a bad assumption about workflow name matching, requiring a follow-up fix.

Stale required status checks in main's branch protection ('Release Preview', 'Verify E2E Passed') blocked the PR #616 merge despite all real CI being green — root cause was non-obvious to the user until investigated.
First scaffold CI run on PR #617 had two failures (Cargo Linux toolchain components, zizmor) requiring two more push/verify cycles.
